title: My Family Home
text:
My family lives in a small house on a quiet street. There are four people in my family: my mother, my father, my sister, and me. My mother is a teacher. My father likes to cook dinner on Sundays.

My sister is ten years old. She likes to draw pictures of animals. In the evening, we all sit together in the living room and talk about our day. I love my family very much.

questions.text: How many people are in the family?
How does the writer feel about the family?
What can we guess about the evenings in this family?
options: They are spent together and talking

vocabulary.definition: to make food by heating it

paragraph_translations: Mi familia vive en una casa pequeña en una calle tranquila. Hay cuatro personas en mi familia: mi madre, mi padre, mi hermana y yo. Mi madre es maestra. A mi padre le gusta cocinar la cena los domingos.
Mi hermana tiene diez años. A ella le gusta hacer dibujos de animales. Por la noche, todos nos sentamos juntos en la sala y hablamos de nuestro día. Quiero mucho a mi familia.
